description:
Lists the reading domains (genres, cultures, periods and themes) the reader has made progress in through ReadingRate, with their mastery stage in each (newcomer, exploring, well read, analytical, expert), books completed and time spent. Up to 50 domains, the deepest first.

Use when the reader asks what areas they have read deeply in, what they know most about, or how their domain progress looks. For one domain's full metrics and what the next stage needs, use get_reading_domain. For poetic forms, use get_poetic_form_mastery.
name: list_reading_domains

domains.description: Up to 50 domains, focus domains first, then by books completed

message.description: Human-readable note when the reader has no domain progress yet

note.description: Present when some domains were left out

title: List reading domains
